CONNORS.author: Larry Connors
CONNORS.verified_rule: Buy one unit at close above 200-day MA with RSI4 below25; add second unit if RSI4 below20 while open; sell above55. This is not a grid algorithm.

GUPPY.author: Daryl Guppy
GUPPY.original_market_timeframe: Stocks; explicitly intraday and longer-term; exact periods not transcribed from image
GUPPY.verified_rule: Two groups of averages; long-group separation measures strength, short-group separation activity, cross-group separation trend character; avoid crossover-only use.

OBV.author: TradingView
OBV.verified_rule: Add current volume on higher close, subtract on lower close, unchanged on equal close. Indicator context does not specify the repository's crossover entry or lifecycle.
